text:
sara-eng: heads-up — CI on master turned red after a lockfile regen, failing on macOS integration tests.

ci-bot: build <https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/12345|#12345> failed on job `macos-3.11`; failing test: `tests/integration/test_http_client.py::test_retry_and_timeout`.

ashwin-dev: can someone rerun the job? suspect a transitive bump (httpcore/anyio) from the regen.

liam-sre: pushing a rerun now, but if it persists we should bisect the lockfile to find the offending commit.

ci-bot: retriggered <https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/12346|#12346> (rerun initiated by @liam-sre).

elaine-qa: rerun queued on macOS runner.

ci-bot: job completed — still failing. log excerpt:
```
E   httpx.ReadTimeout: ReadTimeout('Read operation timed out')
tests/integration/test_http_client.py:87: AssertionError
```

sara-eng: pasted the relevant part of the lock diff that coincides with the regen:
```
- httpcore=0.17.2 -> httpcore=0.18.0
- anyio=3.6.2 -> anyio=3.7.0
```

ashwin-dev: that could change socket/read behavior. Can someone run the lock bisect script (`./scripts/lock_bisect.sh`) to narrow the commit range?

sara-eng: running bisect now: `./scripts/lock_bisect.sh 2026-03-12 2026-03-14` — will report back.

sara-eng: bisect points to commit `abcdef7` where `poetry lock` pulled `httpcore 0.18.0`.

ashwin-dev: OK — quick mitigation: pin `httpcore` back to the 0.17.x line in `pyproject.toml` (or add a `constraints.txt` for CI) and open a hotfix PR to unbreak master.

simon-platform: agree. Also recommend adding the constraints file into the CI image build so transient installs won't drift on runner images.

sara-eng: hotfix PR opened: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7890|#7890> — pins `httpcore==0.17.*` and notes the bisect. reviewers please take a look.

elaine-qa: running the test matrix against the PR now.

ci-bot: PR build <https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/12347|#12347> shows macOS job green.

ashwin-dev: thanks — once we merge, let's follow up with a small integration that fails the lock-regen PR if `httpcore` or `anyio` jumps major/minor unexpectedly.

liam-sre: I'll open an infra task to bake constraints into the macOS runner images.

sara-eng: closing the loop here; will update the ticket with the bisect results and the mitigation. :tada:
